entry.title: New: BILL003(24) (Honolulu) — MAYOR
entry.content:
RELATING TO INCENTIVES FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF AFFORDABLE RENTAL HOUSING.

Amends ROH Chapter 32, Article 4, by clarifying that the grants issued under ROH Chapter 32, Article 4 are post-construction grants; clarifying and updating the eligibility criteria for the post-construction grants and specifying the grant amount an owner of a zoning lot on which is situated an affordable housing project is eligible to receive, which depends on the size of the units; updating the application requirements for the post-construction grants; clarifying and updating the process by which the DPP and the BFS must process and award the post-construction grants to eligible owners; clarifying and updating the process by which an owner who receives a post-construction grant may be subject to certain penalties and the enforcement of those penalties on the owner by the DPP; and updating the reporting requirements for post-construction grants that were awarded and the frequency of submission of those reporting requirements (every three years) by the DPP to the City Council.

Latest action: Returned approved.
